_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil breaker already showing risk-off (near-zero ETF flows, extreme skew/longs, weak CVD) plus multi-venue outflows while F&G/30d tape still sit on Complacency, so the only legal adjacent step is down one rung.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls Anxiety/DOWN/low; narrative supplies outflow color and bottom pattern label without a matching forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed breaks below 46 and 30d BTC momentum turns negative while ETF flows stay near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound toward mid-range and Fear & Greed pushes above 62 with positive 30d momentum
